title: How Well Do LLMs Identify Cultural Unity in Diversity?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on a contrastive matching task for cross-cultural concepts (food and clothing) to assess performance disparities between well-represented and under-represented (long-tail) cultural concepts, as well as comparing accuracy across different geo-cultural groups (e.g., Eastern vs. Western cultures).
Measuring the consistency of the language model's predictions by flipping the order of the candidate concepts in the prompt to detect intrinsic preferences for the first or second option.
